title: Guard block machine
statement: For a machine format $F$ and a natural number $b$, define a Turing machine with no work tapes, binary input, and state set consisting of a halt state together with phases $0$ through $b$. It starts at phase $0$; in the halt state it halts, and at any phase it halts if the scanned input is blank, while on a present input symbol it moves the input head one step and advances the phase by one modulo $b+1$.
caveat: The helper inputMoveAction is not defined in the supplied snippet, so the other components of its actions cannot be confirmed.
